title: The determinants of a cross market arbitrage opportunity: theory and evidence for the European bond market
authors: Marcelo S. Perlin, Alfonso Dufour, Chris Brooks
abstract: This paper investigates the factors that drive the occurrence of arbitrage opportunities across different trading platforms in fixed income markets. We develop a structural model that decomposes the likelihood of a cross-market arbitrage opportunity into fixed costs of trading, price update delays, and order flow impact, and test it empirically using European bond market data.
